summary: Create a "Propose Day" special web page.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Romantic hero background illustration with soft gradients, subtle bokeh, and heart motifs (propose-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
- Minimal elegant heart emblem/icon with a warm accent color (heart-emblem.dim_512x512.png)
- Small repeating heart pattern tile, subtle and low-contrast (heart-pattern-tile.dim_512x512.png)

existing_features.title: Create a responsive, single-page “Propose Day” special webpage with a romantic hero section (headline, short subtext, primary call-to-action button) and clear scrolling structure (hero, message section, reasons/notes section, proposal question section, footer).

Add an interactive “Will you be mine?” proposal section that supports a simple, client-side interaction: clicking “Yes” shows a celebratory confirmation state; clicking “Not yet” shows a gentle, non-blocking secondary state encouraging reconsideration. Keep all interactions purely client-side (no persistence required).
Apply a coherent visual theme for a romantic “Propose Day” page (avoid blue/purple). Define and use a consistent palette, typography scale, spacing, and decorative elements across all sections.

Add required generated images as static assets and incorporate them into the page design (e.g., hero background/illustration, heart motif). Store them under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference them directly from the frontend.

new_feature_requests.summary: Design and build a Propose Day special web page
